bio: The Slaughters Manor House is one of the finest 17th century country houses in the south of England, standing in its own lovely gardens next to the historic church in the heart of the beautiful Cotswold village of Lower Slaughter, regarded by many as the most beautiful village in England.  Located in the heart of the Cotswolds, during the summer, the gardens and the village are a delight. In the winter months, if it's cold and wet outside, there's no better way to relax with Afternoon Tea in front of the real log fires. This 4-star manor house combines contemporary interiors with country charm.  Enjoy the great British tradition of Afternoon Tea, complete with home-made finger sandwiches, fruit and plain scones with clotted cream and seasonal preserves, and a selection of delicious sweets and fancies. Afternoon Tea is served with your choice of Newby London teas or coffee. Guests in a decadent mood can upgrade with a glass of bubbles alongside their Afternoon Tea.  Many well-known Cotswolds towns and villages are within easy reach, and the nearest stations are Moreton-in-Marsh or Kingham.
